description: Claude Code's /config settings panel, which the user opened: a tab strip (Settings Status Config Usage Stats) under the dialog's top rule, a Search settings box, then a ❯-highlighted list of setting names with their values in a second column. The model read it as a cursor question with every setting as an answer button, so the pane sat in Needs you and a tap toggled a setting. A tabbed panel is the user browsing, not the agent asking, so classify() drops the question and the pane is idle. Real capture from an isolated Claude Code (tmux-rc, 2026-10-09), only the cwd changed.
